verdict.rationale: Docs describe Copilot agent mode editing files across the workspace, cloud agents that plan/explore/execute tasks autonomously (including from plain-language issue/PR descriptions via @copilot mentions), and code review/autofix capabilities, directly matching the story of describing a feature/bug and having it implemented across multiple files. Community evidence corroborates real usage of the agent for multi-file/complex code tasks, though some hands-on reports note quality limitations on nuanced 'fix the bug' requests. Missing for 10: rigorous independent benchmarking of multi-file correctness and more first-hand accounts specifically of cross-file feature implementation success/failure rates.
